verdict.rationale: Vue's docs describe a "truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization," which directly matches relying on a compiler instead of hand-written diffing. A community comment that Vue is faster than React loosely supports the performance side. The evidence, though, is a single homepage tagline with no technical detail on how updates are targeted. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the compiler produces surgical, fine-grained DOM updates (e.g. static hoisting or patch flags), independent benchmarks or hands-on corroboration of update efficiency.
